name: The Haunted Isle
summary: Krazek keeps his ears open for unusual rumors throughout Booty Bay on behalf of Baron Revilgaz. A tale shared by tavern sailors speaks of a haunted island off the coast, inhabited by water elementals and the ghost of a raving goblin. Delivering this rumor to Revilgaz piques the baron's interest in an ancient troll legend.

sections.title: Tavern Tales in Booty Bay
sections.body: In the bustling port of Booty Bay, Krazek gathers word of anything unusual happening throughout Stranglethorn Vale at the request of Baron Revilgaz. While Krazek normally pays little heed to spectral gossip, stories told by sailors drinking in the local tavern caught his attention. They speak of an offshore isle occupied by water elementals and haunted by a raving goblin ghost, so he asks you to relay the story to the baron.

sections.title: A Troll Legend
sections.body: Upon hearing Krazek's report of the haunted isle, Baron Revilgaz recalls an old troll legend he once read about in a book. The presence of water elementals and the goblin apparition leads the baron to suspect that an ancient relic, the Stone of the Tides, might finally be within his grasp to add to his personal collection of artifacts.

faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Baron Revilgaz?
faq.answer: Krazek asks you to deliver the rumor to Baron Revilgaz after overhearing an unsettling tale from local sailors in the Booty Bay tavern.

faq.q: What rumors did the sailors share?
faq.answer: The sailors reported an island off the coast that is overrun with water elementals and haunted by the ghost of a raving goblin.

faq.q: Why does Baron Revilgaz care about a ghost story?
faq.answer: The baron remembers a troll legend recorded in an old book. The bizarre accounts from the island suggest that an ancient relic called the Stone of the Tides might actually be located there.

faq.q: Where does this investigation lead next?
faq.answer: Baron Revilgaz directs your attention toward the ancient relic itself, continuing the pursuit in the next step, The Stone of the Tides.
